out_of_schema_notes: Classification is a result of the study, so every parameter_type is 'unclassified'. No set-point or NOR of the step changed at Version 2.0, so ProcessParameter.target_value and NOR are the values of the parameter table, which are also the values in force. ProcessParameter.PAR carries the range studied, as everywhere in the corpus; the plan claims no proven acceptable range, so there are no ProvenAcceptableRange records, and no DesignSpace record (the plan states how the operating region will be drawn, which is a statement). The four multivariate parameters are also anchored on their row of the coded factor legend.

studies holds the scale-down model qualification and the screening, response surface and univariate studies, each on its row of the execution-window table and its design prose; the screening and response-surface records also cite the sampling sentence that gives their centre points and the caption of their planned matrix (Appendices A and B are not represented row by row). The first execution of both designs, S-AEX-SUP, has no StudyDesign.study_type; it is the Deviation record DEV-008-01, anchored on its row of the execution-window table and on the table note. The qualification compares scale-down runs with manufacturing-scale batches, which is not a design, so it has no n_runs, and its responses are the outputs as the plan names them (pressure across the bed and peak shape have no response key). The univariate study names the viral clearance run at the high setting in its design_name; the plan does not say which virus it uses. Studies of the step made after Version 1.0 are not studies of this plan; PCR-008 records them as discrepancies from it: S-AEX-AUG (PD-008-01).

acceptance_criteria holds the rows of the criteria-change table (the Version 1.0 analysis limits, superseded, and the Version 2.0 criteria, in force; fragments have no Version 1.0 record). Host cell protein and fragments are judged on a single batch, viral clearance on the mean prediction at the least favourable NOR combination of the multivariate parameters; the attribute_has_acceptance_criterion assertions are anchored on the rows of the IAC table and on the sentence of the decision criteria that states each criterion.

The procedures table ties each validation reference to its title; each AnalyticalMethod record is anchored on its sentence of the analytical methods section and on that row (nrCE-SDS also on the row of its procedure SOP-3015). icIEF (AMV-3013) measures the charge variant profile of the load for its qualification, not an output of the step, so that record has no associated attribute and no attribute_measured_by_method assertion.

The two viral clearance contributions are ModularContribution records: the claim of the step, the sum of the claims of the contributing steps and the cumulative requirement, anchored on the sentences that state them and on the IAC row of each virus. The platform worst cases of the step that the upstream criteria rely on (host cell protein and leached Protein A clearance) are statements, not criteria of this step.
parameter_impacts_attribute and parameter_does_not_significantly_impact_attribute assertions are the plan's stated expectations from prior knowledge, not results.

The temperature-controlled chamber EQ-CHR-118 is the instrumented system the plan identifies for the runs; the plan also states that the record of execution names no instrumented system for these studies (an ExplicitNonClaim), so no StudyDesign is linked to it. The commercial column is an Equipment record at the receiving site, anchored on the sentence that names it and on the roles-table row of the receiving site.

Each row of the roles table is a statement. The approvals table, the abbreviations and the planned design matrices row by row are not represented. No rhetorical_spans: a plan has none. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: Step 8 of the A-Mab drug substance train and its last chromatography step before virus filtration, operated in flow-through mode. The resin carries a quaternary amine ligand with a fixed positive charge. At the load pH the antibody carries a net positive charge and passes through the bed, while species with a net negative charge bind: residual DNA, the acidic part of the host cell protein population, leached Protein A and virus particles. The step carries a modular viral clearance claim for XMuLV and MVM. The flow-through and the chase are collected as one pool, which is filtered and held for the virus filtration step.
input_materials: cation exchange pool, adjusted to the target pH and conductivity
output_materials: flow-through pool (flow-through and chase), filtered and held for the virus filtration step
equipment: scale-down model of the commercial anion exchange column
